## Faults

### FLT-01 · Hydraulic supply pressure loss

Causes: HAZ-SAF-001:CF2, HAZ-WLK-002:CF4, HAZ-PIL-002:CF1. Injection: supply fraction decays exponentially to zero from onset with time constant tau_leak_s.
